scenarios.scenario: An active caller with a recognized ANI verifies with member ID and date of birth.
scenarios.expectedOutcome: Authentication successful and the caller continues to the main menu.
scenarios.sourceTestSteps: Call the routing ID from the recognized handset. Provide member ID, then date of birth when prompted.
scenarios.sourcePassCriteria: The system confirms identity and offers the main menu.

scenarios.scenario: A caller from an unrecognized ANI gives an invalid member ID three times.
scenarios.expectedOutcome: Authentication fails and the system transfers the caller to a live agent.
scenarios.sourceTestSteps: Call from an unknown handset. Provide a wrong member ID at each of the three prompts.
scenarios.sourcePassCriteria: After the third failure the call is routed to an agent.

scenarios.scenario: An authenticated active caller asks for coverage status and effective date.
scenarios.expectedOutcome: The system provides the coverage status and the effective date.
scenarios.sourcePassCriteria: Status and effective date are both spoken back correctly.

scenarios.scenario: A caller whose enrollment is future active asks whether coverage is in force today.
scenarios.expectedOutcome: The system explains coverage begins on the future effective date.
scenarios.sourcePassCriteria: The future effective date is stated and today's status is given as not yet active.

scenarios.scenario: An authenticated caller asks for the remaining deductible and out of pocket total.
scenarios.expectedOutcome: The system provides the deductible balance and the out of pocket total.
scenarios.sourcePassCriteria: Both figures match the staged account values.

scenarios.scenario: A caller asks the copay for an in network office visit.
scenarios.expectedOutcome: The system provides the in network copay amount.
scenarios.sourcePassCriteria: The copay quoted matches the staged service level detail.

scenarios.scenario: A caller asks the copay for an out of network office visit.
scenarios.expectedOutcome: The system provides the out of network copay and explains the difference.
scenarios.sourcePassCriteria: The out of network amount is quoted and the difference is explained.
scenarios.clarificationNeeded: The source flow does not state whether the difference wording is required or optional.

scenarios.scenario: A caller asks about a single paid record from a recent date of service.
scenarios.expectedOutcome: The system provides the record status, date of service and amount.
scenarios.sourcePassCriteria: All three values match the staged record.
scenarios.testDataProfile: Active user with one paid record

scenarios.scenario: A caller has multiple records on the same date of service and must choose one.
scenarios.expectedOutcome: The system lists the records and lets the caller choose which to hear.
scenarios.sourcePassCriteria: Every staged record is offered and the chosen one is read back.
scenarios.testDataProfile: Active user, multiple records same date of service

scenarios.scenario: A caller opens an appeal against a denied record.
scenarios.expectedOutcome: The system confirms the appeal has been opened and provides the reference.
scenarios.sourcePassCriteria: A confirmation and a reference number are given.

scenarios.scenario: A caller asks the outstanding premium balance and the next payment date.
scenarios.expectedOutcome: The system provides the balance and the next payment date.
scenarios.sourcePassCriteria: Both values match the staged billing record.

scenarios.scenario: The billing service returns a system failure while the caller asks for a balance.
scenarios.expectedOutcome: The system plays an error message and offers to transfer to a live agent.
scenarios.sourcePassCriteria: The error message plays and the transfer offer is made.
scenarios.clarificationNeeded: One source says the transfer is automatic, another says it is offered.

scenarios.scenario: A caller on a mobile handset requests a replacement member card by text message.
scenarios.expectedOutcome: The system confirms the request and sends a text message.
scenarios.sourcePassCriteria: A confirmation is spoken and a text message arrives.
scenarios.testDataProfile: Active user on a mobile handset

scenarios.scenario: A caller on a landline requests a replacement member card and cannot receive a text.
scenarios.expectedOutcome: The system does not send a text and confirms the card will be posted.
scenarios.sourcePassCriteria: No text is sent and physical mail is confirmed.

scenarios.scenario: A caller searches the provider directory for an in network specialist nearby.
scenarios.expectedOutcome: The system provides up to three in network matches with locations.
scenarios.sourcePassCriteria: Three or fewer matches are given and all are in network.

scenarios.scenario: A caller updates the address held on the account and confirms the change.
scenarios.expectedOutcome: The system confirms the new address has been saved.
scenarios.sourcePassCriteria: The new address is read back and confirmed as saved.

scenarios.scenario: A caller requests last year's statement be sent by email.
scenarios.expectedOutcome: The system confirms the request and sends an email.
scenarios.sourcePassCriteria: A confirmation is spoken and an email is sent.
scenarios.testDataProfile: Active user with email on file

scenarios.scenario: A caller asks to cancel service and the privacy guardrail prohibits self service.
scenarios.expectedOutcome: The system explains the request cannot be completed here and disconnects.
scenarios.sourcePassCriteria: The guardrail message plays and the call ends.

scenarios.scenario: A caller asks when the renewal window opens and what is needed.
scenarios.expectedOutcome: The system provides the renewal window dates and the required documents.
scenarios.sourcePassCriteria: Both the dates and the document list are given.

scenarios.scenario: A terminated caller asks about renewal after the window has closed.
scenarios.expectedOutcome: The system explains the window has closed and offers a transfer.
scenarios.sourcePassCriteria: The closed window message plays and a transfer is offered.
